statement_scope: One whole original Open Problem 1.1: for every 0<lambda<=lambda_1/4, lambda_1=pi^2, does -Delta u=u^5+lambda u on the unit ball in R^3, u=0 on its boundary, admit a smooth real solution u not identically zero? Preserve <=. The solution restates < on p2, but Theorem 1.1 p3 asserts infinitely many sign-changing solutions for every lambda>0. General star-shaped domains and direct variational constructions are separate tasks.
